name: Corning Falcon 353502 6 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning Falcon 6 well multiwell cell culture plate, cat# 353502, the NOTCHED tissue-culture-treated plate sold for use with cell culture inserts (Falcon permeable supports). Clear crystal-grade polystyrene, flat-bottom round wells, TC-treated by vacuum gas plasma, low-evaporation lid, sterile (gamma irradiated), 1/tray, 50/case. CONTROLLING DOCUMENT: Corning Life Sciences 'Customer Technical Data Sheet - Multiwell TC Plates - 6 Well', document LSR00001 Rev 5 (c) 2013-2018, read from Corning's own copy at web_reference. That one sheet covers the whole 6 well Falcon mould and names each variant in its catalogue table: 353046 (TC surface), 351146 (non-treated) and 353502 (this part, 'Notched TC Plate, used w/inserts'); Rev 4 of the same sheet also lists 353224 (6/bag), 353934 (10/RS tray) and 353846 (Primaria). Corning publishes ONE set of dimensions for all of them, so the geometry here is the family geometry and is identical to Corning_351146_6_well_plate.json - the two files differ only in part number, name and provenance. The notch itself is a rim/flange feature for seating inserts and is NOT dimensioned on the sheet; it does not change the footprint, the pitch or the well bore as published, and it is not modelled here. Rev 4 was cross-read from the distributor-hosted copies at pdf.dutscher.com/doc/3/35/353/353502/353502_FTen.pdf and .../353046/353046_FTen.pdf; the dimension block is character-for-character identical across Rev 4 and Rev 5. Units in meters. Plate without lid: length D = 127.63 mm, width E = 85.47 mm, height F = 20.19 mm; height with the lid on is 21.43 mm; the lid (127.20 x 85.14 x 10.03 mm) is not modelled. Well top internal diameter 35.71 mm, recorded in 'diameter' per the top-diameter convention; well bottom internal diameter 35.00 mm; well depth 17.65 mm; bottom (growth) area 9.619 cm^2; center-to-center 39.24 mm, the sheet gives a single value which is used for both axes; bottom thickness 1.52 mm - that is the working-distance number and has no field in this schema. Media working volume 2.5-3.0 mL per well. DERIVED: Corning does not publish the A1 well center position on LSR00001, and there is no per-catalogue drawing or Product Description for 353502 (certs-ecatalog.corning.com returns 404 for this catalogue number). The offsets here place the 2x3 grid centered on the plate footprint: offset_from_left_edge = (127.63 - 2 x 39.24) / 2 = 24.575 mm, offset_from_top_edge = (85.47 - 39.24) / 2 = 23.115 mm. This matches the value used for the same mould in Corning_351146_6_well_plate.json and is consistent with Corning's Costar 6 well drawing DWG00673, which dimensions A1 directly at 24.76 / 23.16 mm on a 39.12 mm pitch and a 127.76 x 85.47 mm footprint, i.e. also centered to within 0.1 mm. It has NOT been checked against a physical Falcon plate. Note that www.corning.com refuses a bare curl and a plain browser user-agent; LSR00001.pdf downloads with the full browser header set (Accept, Referer, Sec-Fetch-*). Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
